headline: The new Fitbit Edge leaks
summary: New Fitbit Edge, a successor to the Charge line, has leaked. Images from Android Headlines reveal its design. Google's rumored fitness tracker splits the difference between Pixel Watch and Charge.

headline: Prick's theatrical industrial punk is perfect for spooky season
summary: Trent Reznor produced tracks on Prick's self-titled debut album. The band's theatrical industrial punk sound is ideal for spooky season. Reznor's production talents were lent to old friend Kevin McMahon.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon is already offering early Prime Big Deal Day discounts. Deals include Amazon's own hardware and other popular products. October Prime Day officially kicks off on October 6th.

headline: NJ's former Lt Gov is using AI to say he's innocent of sexual harassment
summary: Former NJ Lt. Governor Dale Caldwell resigned after sexual harassment investigation. He used AI during an interview to assert his innocence. Caldwell continues to make media rounds to clear his name.

headline: Lanterns Star Kyle Chandler's Hal Jordan Is a Superhero Casting That Rivals Robert Downey Jr.'s Iron Man, Fans Say
summary: Lanterns Season 1 has concluded with strong fan reactions. Fans praise Kyle Chandler's portrayal of Hal Jordan. His casting is compared to Robert Downey Jr.'s iconic Iron Man.

headline: Lanterns Season 1 Finale Review & Recap
summary: Lanterns Episode 8 serves as the Season 1 finale. The episode delivers an emotionally satisfying conclusion. While twists are predictable, the ending resonates well.

headline: Mighty Mike Plays Dad Says He Owns 'Like 12 Companies,' Promises Refunds for AI Shirts
summary: Mighty Mike Plays' dad, Dave, promised refunds for AI-generated shirts. He issued a lengthy explanation regarding the recent controversy. The drama follows online demands for more information on YouTube ads.

headline: Blindfolded Tekken 8 Player Achieves One of the Game's Top Ranks from Beginner
summary: Professional Tekken 8 player SuperBrine went viral. He reached the God of Destruction rank with Alisa. The impressive feat was accomplished while completely blindfolded.

headline: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
summary: The US has withdrawn all bombers from RAF Fairford base. No official reason has been provided for the removal. This follows a major incident with suspicious vehicles last week.

headline: Andrew takes legal action over search warrants relating to arrest
summary: Mountbatten-Windsor is pursuing legal action. The action relates to search warrants connected to his arrest. He was arrested in February on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

headline: Polanski banned from Israel after party's motion declaring 'Zionism is racism'
summary: Polanski has been banned from entering Israel. The ban follows a party's motion declaring 'Zionism is racism'. The controversial vote has caused significant internal party divisions.

headline: Protesters scuffle with police as migrants brought ashore on south coast
summary: Protesters clashed with police on the UK's south coast. Migrants were brought ashore and taken to a processing center. The Home Office confirmed 149 migrants were processed in Kent.
